resolved_conflicts.explanation: Murphy credits the U.S. Forest Service and dates the tower to probably the 1930s from memory. The Central US Lookouts list says Texas Forest Service. The story reports both; no official record was found to settle it.

sources.title: Bob Bowman's East Texas Fire Lookout Towers

notes_for_editor: Murphy's column is a memoir-style recollection from a writer who grew up in the 1940s and 1950s, not an agency record. The 1930s date and the U.S. Forest Service credit are his memory; the Central US Lookouts list says Texas Forest Service. Murphy also describes a different tower south of Red Hills Lake in Sabine County; it is not used here. The record's coordinates (31.53436, -94.13627) were not checked against the location Murphy describes. The Central US page has a Picture link that was not followed; no photo is recorded. Access and ownership of the site are not described in the sources read.
